point_left.title: Liberty Leading the People
point_left.description: The painting depicts a bare-breasted woman personifying Liberty leading a diverse group of revolutionaries over a barricade strewn with the dead, waving the French tricolor flag amidst a smoky, chaotic battlefield.

point_left_mid.title: The Birth of Venus
point_left_mid.description: The painting depicts the goddess Venus standing nude on a giant scallop shell as she arrives on shore, while the wind gods Zephyr and Chloris blow her toward land and a female figure waits to cover her with a floral robe.

point_front_left.title: The Scream
point_front_left.description: A distorted, skull-like figure stands on a bridge with hands to its face in a gesture of agony, set against a swirling, blood-red sky.

point_front_right.title: Water Lilies
point_front_right.description: The painting depicts a tranquil pond surface filled with floating green lily pads and soft pink flowers, rendered in loose, shimmering brushstrokes of blue and green.

point_right_mid.title: Las Meninas
point_right_mid.description: The painting depicts a complex scene in the royal court of Spain, featuring the young Infanta Margarita surrounded by her maids of honor, dwarfs, and a dog, with the artist himself visible at his easel in the foreground.

point_right.title: A Sunday Afternoon on the Island of La Grande Jatte
point_right.description: The painting depicts a group of people relaxing on a grassy bank by a river, rendered in a distinctive style of small, distinct dots of color.
